manual.title: Manual Registration — Detailed Single Entry
manual.desc: For registrations outside forms: single applications via e-mail, phone intakes and field calls. Creates the person if missing; if the e-mail matches, the registration opens on the existing person.
manual.notesPh: Internal note — e.g. incoming e-mail reference…
manual.emailExists: This e-mail already exists: {name} — the registration will open on the existing person.

import.title: Bulk Registration Import (Excel / CSV)
import.desc: For company lists and bulk registrations arriving via e-mail: pick a file, review the preview, then import. Duplicate and invalid rows are skipped and reported automatically.
import.noIssues: All rows are valid — ready to import.
import.colNotMapped: Expected columns not found — use the template (First + Last name required).

export.title: Export Registrations (Excel)
export.desc: Current status filter and search apply to the export. With an organization filter, the official confirmation document format is produced.
export.companyPh: e.g. Acme Inc. — empty for all
export.officialHint: Header + event details + registration table + signature block — a ready document for 'your registrations are completed, final official approval' correspondence with organizations.
export.startedDesc: The document is being saved to your downloads.
